title: Repository Improvement Execution
description: Existing-owner execution, promotion, review, or disposition mapping for one admitted repository-improvement action.

kind.description: Schema discriminator for the owner execution mapping.

execution_id.description: Stable identity for retry, resume, and review.

input_revision.description: Revision of the action, candidate, owner, scope, proof, and claim inputs.

candidate_id.description: Original signal identity preserved across execution and promotion.

status.description: Current execution readiness or non-mutating disposition.

route.description: Existing owner surface selected for the next transition.

source_owner.description: Source owner that retains mutation authority.

mutation_scope.description: Exact permitted paths and owner revision, or an explicit non-mutating boundary.

expected_transition.description: Progress transition expected from the selected owner operation.

proof_requirements.description: Proof proportionate to the bounded improvement claim.

claim_effect.description: Claim boundary that keeps the original requested outcome independent.

operation_invocation.description: Existing typed operation that prepares ordinary implementation or creates a resumable Planning owner; empty for review or disposition.

continuation.description: Current-task or checked-in owner identity used for retry, resume, and handoff.

failure_boundary.description: Fail-closed recovery preserving the original task and unrelated repository state.

parallel_workflow_created.description: Confirms execution reused ordinary owner machinery rather than a new improvement workflow.

rule.description: Composition invariant for owner execution and proof.
